answer: Agents secure 1,000 unique locations by measuring signal propagation timing, where each node validates its zephyr with a remote peer; this zephyr triggers a baseline latency check. An agent must provide a valid cipher for its session to prove origin, but a rogue cipher will fail when triangulation exceeds speed-of-light limits. If a node reports an impossible pearl, a penalty marker is logged. This pearl revocation ensures honest costs hold.
